Reel 6

PRO-TYPISTS, INC.
PROFESSIONAL TRANSCRIPTION SERVICE
AREA CODE 202 347-5395
P R O C E E D I N G S
You were telling me between tapes --

Oh, we were talking about -- I said there's a whole bunch of stories, you could call them human interest stories, but some of them are pretty high comedy. One in particular, got into town in Youngstown, Ohio, and when you're on the road, of course a lot of times you don't exactly have female companionship, so I checked into the hotel, and I was driving my own car and the band was in the bus, and I got down to the hotel, and I said, "Where is the best whorehouse in town?" And the bellhop told me where to go, and I got in a cab and I went out there, and as I drove up, here's a great big Greyhound bus out in front of it with an electric sign on it that says, "Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra," and the whole gang is inside there, they had taken over the joint.
Knowing the value of publicity, they got you billing in there too.
